answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 182820 Country: India Title: Daughter name as AMAIRA OR AMAIRAH Question: Please suggest if both names are correct or incorrect. if it’s correct Muslim baby girl name then please mention their meanings. It’s urgent. Answer ID: 182820 Posted on: Sep 27, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 158/63/SN=2/1443) The name Umairah (with dhamma on ‘ain’ and fatha on ‘meem’) is a name given to girl. There have been some Sahabiyat with this name. (Usdul Ghabah, 7/202) Thus, it should be written in English as ‘Umairah’. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
